title: Workplace Safety Assessment
description: Evaluates the overall safety practices, hazard controls, and compliance posture of the workplace to protect employees and visitors

questions.text: Are emergency exits clearly marked, unobstructed, and accessible at all times?
Are fire extinguishers in place, regularly inspected, and staff trained on their use?
Is a first aid kit available and stocked, with at least one trained first aider on site?
Are all electrical panels, wiring, and equipment in safe working condition and inspected periodically?
Is PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) available, maintained, and used appropriately for relevant roles?
Has a formal risk assessment been conducted and reviewed within the last 12 months?
Are incident and near-miss reports being recorded and reviewed for corrective action?
Have all employees received safety induction and role-specific safety training?

title: Harassment & Discrimination Prevention Assessment
description: Assesses the organization's policies, awareness, and response mechanisms to prevent harassment and discrimination in the workplace

questions.text: Is there a written anti-harassment and anti-discrimination policy that all employees have acknowledged?
Has the organization provided POSH (Prevention of Sexual Harassment) or equivalent training to all staff in the past year?
Is an Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) or equivalent body constituted and active?
Are complaint channels (anonymous or named) accessible and clearly communicated to all employees?
Are complaints addressed within defined SLAs and outcomes documented?
Is there a non-retaliation policy and has it been communicated to all employees?
